have.what: LTV vs cost-to-serve per connected pump

derivation.method: per-pump ARR and cost rates over active sites × 5-year undiscounted horizon; ratio = Σ ARR ÷ Σ cost_to_serve on raw sums (horizon cancels), rounded for display only

have.what: ARR vs cost-to-serve per pump by site size

derivation.method: per size band over active sites: Σ ARR ÷ Σ pumps and Σ cost_to_serve ÷ Σ pumps

have.what: Mean hardware discount by site size

derivation.method: simple mean of hardware_discount_pct across active subscribed sites, per band and overall

have.what: E-04.2 threshold sensitivity — miss vs sampling noise

derivation.method: margin = raw mean hardware_discount_pct − tolerance; SE = sample standard deviation (n−1) ÷ √n over active sites; knife-edge flagged when |margin| ≤ 1pp or |margin| ≤ 2 × SE
